The rsutil module

The `rsutil` module is the core of the RS-utils package. It provides utilities for processing lattice structures in RS-LMTO-ASA calculations, including:

  • Lattice Processing: The main process_lattice() function calculates optimal Wigner-Seitz radii and generates starting parameters for atomic calculations.

  • Data Visualization: Interactive 3D visualization of atomic structures and magnetic properties.

  • Exchange Interactions: Generation of exchange interaction files (J_ij) for spin dynamics simulations.

  • Format Conversion: Export to UppASD format and other simulation engines.

Core Functions

This module provides a Python wrapper for the process_lattice Fortran routine from the rsutil shared library.

Attributes

lib_filenameOptional[str]

The filename of the rsutil shared library, determined dynamically.

lib_pathstr

The full path to the rsutil shared library.

_rsutilctypes.CDLL

The loaded rsutil shared library.

Functions

process_lattice() -> None

Python wrapper for the process_lattice Fortran routine.

rsutil.process_lattice(cluster_type: str = 'periodic', empty_spheres: bool = False, min_empty_radius: float = 1.2, max_empty_radius: float = 2.5) → None

Python wrapper for the process_lattice() Fortran routine.

Parameters

cluster_typestr, optional

Type of cluster: ‘periodic’ (default) or ‘free’. If ‘periodic’, sets pbc to .true. If ‘free’, sets pbc to .false.

empty_spheresbool, optional

Enable empty sphere calculations (default: False).

min_empty_radiusfloat, optional

Minimum empty sphere radius (default: 1.2).

max_empty_radiusfloat, optional

Maximum empty sphere radius (default: 2.5).

Submodules

The package is organized into several submodules:

  • ``rsutil.viz``: Visualization tools for structures and simulations

  • ``rsutil.exchange``: Exchange interaction calculation and mapping

  • ``rsutil.export``: Export functionality for other simulation formats
